map.输入螺栓规格、强度等级与摩擦系数，计算拧紧扭矩、预紧力与应力: Enter bolt size, strength grade and friction coefficient to compute tightening torque, preload and stress.
map.T = K × F × d（扭矩系数法）；F = 预紧比例 × σs × As: T = K times F times d (torque-coefficient method); F = preload ratio times sigma_s times As.
map.基于螺栓拧紧扭矩系数法：拧紧扭矩 T 由扭矩系数 K、预紧力 F 与螺纹公称直径: Based on the bolt tightening torque-coefficient method: tightening torque T is from torque coefficient K, preload F and nominal diameter d; preload F is from strength grade (yield sigma_s), stress area As and preload ratio, for bolt fastening process design.
map.💡 扭矩 T=K×F×d；预紧力 F=比例×σs×As；K≈0.5μ+0.12: Formula: torque T=K times F times d; preload F=ratio times sigma_s times As; K approx 0.5mu+0.12.
map.预紧力一般取屈服强度的 70%，重要场合取 75%: Preload generally 70% of yield, 75% for critical cases.
map.拧紧扭矩为理论值，实际需用扭矩扳手校准: The tightening torque is theoretical; a torque wrench is needed for calibration.
map.📚 深度解析：螺栓拧紧扭矩计算（预紧力与扭矩系数）: In-depth: Bolt tightening torque calculation (preload and torque coefficient)
map.装配工艺：由螺栓规格与强度等级确定扳手扭矩设定值: Assembly process: set the wrench torque from bolt size and strength grade.
map.预紧力核算：反算扭矩对应的轴向预紧力与应力水平: Preload check: back-compute the axial preload and stress level for a given torque.
map.摩擦影响评估：比较润滑/干摩擦状态下扭矩与预紧力的偏差: Friction impact assessment: compare torque and preload deviation under lubricated/dry friction.
Algorithm: preload F = yield-utilization times yield strength times stress area As (As: M6 20.1, M8 36.6, M10 58.0, M12 84.3, M14 115, M16 157, M18 192, M20 245, M22 303, M24 353, M27 459, M30 561 mm2); torque coefficient K = 0.5 times friction mu + 0.12; tightening torque T = K times F times d/1000 (N m, d in mm); actual stress = F/As (MPa); stress/yield ratio = stress/yield times 100%. Friction assessment: mu<0.12 well lubricated, mind over-tightening; <0.18 normal; <0.25 rather dry; else high friction, lubricate advised.
map.例：M10、8.8 级（屈服 640MPa）、μ=0.15、利用率 0.7 →: Example: M10, grade 8.8 (yield 640 MPa), mu=0.15, utilization 0.7 -> As 58.0 mm2, preload 25984 N (25.98 kN), K=0.195, torque 50.7 N m, stress 448 MPa, 70% of yield, assessment: normal friction. If M20, grade 10.9 (900 MPa), mu=0.20, utilization 0.75 -> As 245 mm2, preload 165375 N (165.38 kN), K=0.220, torque 727.7 N m, stress 675 MPa, 75% of yield, assessment: rather dry, mind consistency. Same M10 if mu lowered from 0.15 to 0.10 (well lubricated) -> K drops to 0.170, same torque raises preload from 25984 N to 29805 N, +14.7%, easy to overload.
map.扭矩系数 K = 0.5μ+0.12 从哪来？: Where does torque coefficient K = 0.5mu+0.12 come from?
map.这是把螺纹摩擦与支承面摩擦合并后的简化经验式：0.12 代表螺纹升角与牙型角贡献: This is a simplified empirical formula combining thread and bearing-face friction: 0.12 represents the fixed part from thread lead angle and flank angle, 0.5mu the combined thread and end-face friction. Actual K varies greatly with surface treatment (galvanizing, dacromet, oiling), often 0.10 to 0.30; critical joints should be calibrated by torque-preload tests.
map.为什么预紧应力要控制在屈服的 70% 左右？: Why keep preload stress around 70% of yield?
map.螺栓装配后还会叠加工作载荷，且拧紧过程本身存在 ±15%~±25% 的扭矩散差（: After assembly the bolt also carries the working load, and tightening itself has plusminus 15% to plusminus 25% torque scatter (wrench accuracy and friction fluctuation). The 30% margin avoids actual preload crossing yield and causing plastic elongation or delayed fracture. This tool defaults 0.7; critical cases can lower to 0.5 to 0.6 per code.
map.螺栓拧紧扭矩计算器根据螺栓规格（M6-M30）、强度等级（4.8-12.9级）和: The bolt tightening torque calculator, by bolt size (M6-M30), strength grade (4.8-12.9) and friction coefficient, computes tightening torque, preload and actual stress, providing accurate torque control reference for bolt assembly.
